# About Myth (AI) in MythBrowse

**Myth is an AI assistant. Its answers are generated by a language model and can be wrong,
incomplete, outdated or biased.** Check important information (health, legal, financial, safety)
with reliable sources. Myth is not a professional adviser.

- **Which model answers.** MythBrowse does not include or host a model. Myth sends your messages
  to the model *you* configure: a local Ollama server, or an OpenAI-compatible service with your
  own API key. The model's provider is responsible for the model and for how it handles your
  data; read its terms and privacy policy.
- **When Myth sees a page.** Only when you ask about the page you are on (the Myth panel, or a
  question typed on a web page). Then the page's address, title and visible text and/or your
  selection are sent with that one message. Form fields are never read. Sites you set to
  "Don't share with Myth" are never sent.
- **What Myth can do in this build.** Answer. Builds from this repository cannot open, click or
  type on web pages; that is the proprietary Myth agent in official JustMyth builds.
- **Web content is untrusted.** Pages can contain text written to manipulate AI models
  ("prompt injection"). MythBrowse tells the model to treat page text as data, but no model
  follows that perfectly: be sceptical of answers that push you to act, pay, sign in or reveal
  information.
- **"Ask Myth to fix".** On a broken page Myth can suggest a CSS/JS patch. It runs only in that
  tab as a preview after a static safety review, and is kept for that site only if you press
  Keep. You can remove it at any time in the compatibility panel.
- **Labelling.** Everything Myth writes appears in the Myth chat or panel, marked as Myth's,
  never as page content. If you copy and publish AI-generated text, label it as such where the
  law or the platform requires it.
